programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Pups Save a Waiter-Bot; Pups Stop a Pie-Clone
programs.desc: Mr. Porter's new high-tech waiter robot helps around the café, but it can't stop cleaning; it's up to the pups to clean up the mess; Mayor Humdinger creates a cyclone of delicious pies, and the pups must stop it before the town is covered.

programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Pups Save a Lost Gold Miner; Pups Save Uncle Otis From His Cabin
programs.desc: Uncle Otis takes a trip to gold mine; Uncle Otis installs a Smart Home 3000 in his cabin that ends up trapping him and Mr. Wingnut inside.

programs.title: Peppa Pig
programs.sub_title: Father's Day; Grandpa Pig's Metal Detector; Parking Ticket; Funny Music; Grampy Rabbit's Boatyard
programs.desc: Peppa and George decide to make Father's Day the best day ever; George loses his wind-up robot's key; Daddy Pig gets a parking ticket; Daddy Pig has a new synthesizer; Grandpa Pig goes to Grampy Rabbit's boatyard.

programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Pups Save a Rocket Roller Skater; Pups Save Ryder's Surprise
programs.desc: A mix-up delivery leads to Ms. Marjorie and Danny speeding out of control in Adventure Bay; the Pups must rescue them; Ryder's present ends up in the jungle; Carlos is trapped in a jungle gym.

programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Moto Pups: Pups Save the Donuts; Moto Pups: Pups Save the Kitties
programs.desc: When the Ruff-Ruff Pack steals Mr. Porter's mini-donut maker, the Moto Pups set off to get the machine back in one piece; the Ruff-Ruff Pack takes over Humdinger's lair and runs off with his kitties.

programs.title: Mr. Crocodile
programs.sub_title: Granny Zanny; Croc Gets a Job
programs.desc: Toothy, lovable Mr. Crocodile, with his best friend Daisy by his side, navigates the human world in a series of zany adventures.

programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Mighty Pups Stop a Mighty Eel; Pups Save a Floating Royal Carriage
programs.desc: When an eel accidentally swallows a piece of the meteor and becomes gigantic, it's up to the Mighty Pups to save Adventure Bay; after Sweetie decides to commandeer the Princess's royal carriage and horses, Sid the pirate sends Arrby to steal it.

programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Rescue Knights: Pups Save a Tournament; Rescue Knights: Pups Save the Baby Dragons
programs.desc: The PAW Patrol helps a Mystery Knight and the Princess in disguise win a tournament when Claw and Sparks show up to sabotage the event; the Rescue Knights must save some baby dragons from Claw and reunite them with their mommy.

programs.title: Rubble & Crew
programs.sub_title: The Crew Builds a Skate Park; The Crew Builds a Tunnel
programs.desc: The pups find out Auntie Crane is a secret skateboarding star, but while building a surprise skate park, they have to fix a cement mix mishap; Charger's favorite singer, Sierra Sparkle, is coming to town.

programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Fire Rescue: Pups Save the Flaming Flounder; Fire Rescue: Pups Make the News
programs.desc: Francois' pants catch on fire, sending both the Lighthouse and Cap'n Turbot's Flounder up in flames; a news crew is in town when Chickaletta accidentally causes a fire in Adventure Bay's new parkette.

programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Pups Save a Lonesome Walrus; Pups Save the Hummy Gummies
programs.desc: Wally the Walrus searches all over Adventure Bay for Cap'n Turbot and turns the town upside-down in the process; everybody loves Helga Humdinger's Hummy Gummy treats, causing Mayor Humdinger to get jealous and steal them all.

programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Ultimate Rescue: Pups Save the Opening Ceremonies; Ultimate Rescue: Pups Save the Adventure Bay Games
programs.desc: Marshall leads the pups when an underground fire threatens the Opening Ceremonies in this Ultimate Fire Rescue; Chase and his police-pups must find the missing medals to save the Adventure Bay Games in this Ultimate Police Rescue.
